s: The product was approved by the FDA in September 2020 as a replacement therapy for Adrenocortical Insufficiency (AI) in children under 17 years of age.
The product is the first and only FDA-approved granule hydrocortisone formulation for the treatment of AI designed for use in children.
We believe there are approximately 10,000 children currently suffering from AI in the United States.
